text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Morocco's interior minister and his French counterpart announce the two countries have smashed an international drug smuggling network.
- Political parties step up preparations for the upcoming elections.
- Morocco offers aid to help Angola.
- Police break a Casablanca-based gang specialised in falsifying visas to Italy.
- Opposition Istiqlal party leader M'Hamed Boucetta urges full transparency for the parliamentary elections.
- King Hassan II calls on Moslems to support the holy city of al Qods (Jerusalem).
